title: MIRA: A Musical Intent Refinement Agent for Aligning Text-to-Music Generation with User Intent
title_zh: MIRA: A Musical Intent Refinement Agent for Aligning Text-to-Music Generation with User Intent

paragraphs.en: Text-to-music systems produce increasingly convincing audio, yet evaluation reveals little about whether the result matches user intent. A global text–audio relevance score can overlook the implicit intent in underspecified prompts and mask failures in specific requirements—instrumentation, structure, rhythm, or mood progression. To bridge this gap, we formulate text-to-music intent alignment as satisfying a per-request rubric of independently verifiable items covering both a request’s explicit requirements and its implied musical intent. Scoring items individually makes evaluation diagnostic—by intent source and musical dimension—rather than a single opaque score. We instantiate this as MuRA-Bench, a benchmark of real-world platform requests curated by music experts. We further propose MIRA (Musical Intent Refinement Agent), a test-time agent that first grounds a request’s intent into rubrics, then searches over prompt revisions for a black-box generator under a bounded budget—iteratively generating music, verifying it against the rubrics, and using this feedback to guide a trajectory-aware tree search. Experiments across open-source and commercial backends show that MIRA improves intent alignment, enabling an open-source generator to achieve performance comparable to representative commercial systems (e.g. Suno and Mureka). Project page: https://mirareview.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 文本转音乐系统生成的音频越来越逼真，但评估结果却很少能说明生成内容是否真正符合用户意图。 全局的文本-音频相关性得分可能会忽视表述不明确的提示中所隐含的意图，并掩盖在特定要求上的失败——例如乐器配置、结构、节奏或情绪推进方面。 为了弥合这一差距，我们将文本转音乐的意图对齐问题转化为满足每项请求的一套评分标准，该标准包含可独立验证的条目，既涵盖请求的明确需求，也覆盖其隐含的音乐意图。 对各项评分标准进行单独打分，使评估更具诊断性——能够按意图来源和音乐维度分别分析，而非仅依赖一个不透明的总分。 我们将其具体化为 MuRA-Bench，这是一个由音乐专家精心挑选的真实平台请求基准测试。 我们还提出了 MIRA（音乐意图优化智能体），一个测试阶段的智能体：它首先将请求的意图转化为评分标准，然后在预算限制下通过提示修订来搜索黑箱生成器的最佳方案——迭代生成音乐、对照评分标准进行验证，并利用反馈指导具有轨迹感知的树形搜索。 在开源和商业后端上的实验表明，MIRA 提升了意图对齐效果，使开源生成器能够达到与代表性商业系统（如 Suno 和 Mureka）相当的性能水平。 项目页面：https://mirareview.github.io/ .

paragraphs.en: We therefore formulate text-to-music intent alignment as prompt-specific musical rubric satisfaction . Each request is represented by a set of independently auditable rubric items covering both explicitly stated constraints and musical intent inferred from references and context. The specification varies with the request, revealing which requirements are satisfied or missed alongside overall alignment. We instantiate this formulation in MuRA-Bench , a public benchmark containing 100 controlled music-generation requests derived from anonymized intent seeds collected on the Mureka platform. For each request, a language model drafts a musical rubric, which is then reviewed and revised by a music expert. The requests are divided among three experts following shared revision guidelines.Named references are converted into generalized, audibly verifiable, and copyright-conscious musical traits rather than retained as direct imitation targets.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将文本到音乐的意图对齐问题表述为针对特定提示的音乐评分标准满足问题。 每个请求都由一组可独立审核的评分标准项表示，这些项目涵盖了明确提出的约束条件以及从参考和上下文中推断出的音乐意图。 该规范因请求而异，能够揭示哪些要求得到了满足或未被满足，同时也能反映整体的对齐情况。 我们在 MuRA-Bench 中实现了这一表述，这是一个公开基准测试，包含 100 个受控的音乐生成请求，这些请求源自 Mureka 平台上收集的去匿名化意图种子。 对于每个请求，语言模型会起草一份音乐评分标准，随后由音乐专家进行审查和修订。 这些请求按照共同的修订指南分配给三位专家。指定的参考内容会被转化为可听觉验证且注意版权的通用音乐特征，而非直接作为模仿目标保留。

paragraphs.en: The same rubric perspective also provides an actionable signal for improving generation. Existing methods strengthen prompt following through pre-generation planning or model-specific inference-time control, including reward-guided search, latent optimization, and internal intervention Gong et al. (2026) ; Novack et al. (2024) ; Koo et al. (2025) ; Roy et al. (2025) . We focus on identifying unmet request-specific requirements in completed tracks and converting them into subsequent repairs. We propose MIRA , a Musical Intent Refinement Agent that organizes text-to-music generation as verifier-guided search. MIRA uses the request and tool-grounded musical evidence to construct an online rubric, converts generated audio into requirement-level observations with a music-specialized verifier, and explores alternative prompt states under a bounded generation budget. Feedback is retained along the search structure, allowing subsequent actions to preserve satisfied requirements while targeting unresolved ones. Operating outside the generator, MIRA supports structurally different black-box backends without parameter updates.

paragraphs.en: We validate item-level scores against expert judgments, then compare generators on stated and completed musical intent. We evaluate MIRA on three generation backends under different generation budgets, analyze its major components, and use commercial systems as alignment references. The results show that request-specific evaluation exposes differences obscured by global relevance scores. MIRA consistently improves intent alignment and enables an open-source generator to match or surpass some representative commercial systems under MuRA-Bench evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将项目级评分与专家判断进行验证，然后基于明确声明和实际完成的音乐意图对生成器进行比较。 我们在三种不同生成预算的生成后端上评估 MIRA，分析其主要组件，并使用商业系统作为对齐参考。 结果表明，针对具体请求的评估能够揭示全局相关性评分所掩盖的差异。 MIRA 持续提升了意图对齐效果，并使开源生成器在 MuRA-Bench 评估中能够匹配甚至超越部分代表性商业系统。

paragraphs.en: We formulate text-to-music intent alignment as prompt-specific musical rubric satisfaction and introduce MuRA-Bench , a public benchmark derived from real-world platform requests and revised by three music experts. It enables item-level verification of explicit musical constraints and expert-validated intent inferred from references and context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将文本到音乐的意图对齐问题表述为针对特定提示的音乐评分标准满足问题，并引入了 MuRA-Bench——一个源自真实平台请求、经三位音乐专家修订的公开基准。 它支持对明确的音乐约束进行项目级验证，以及对通过参考和上下文推断出的意图进行专家验证。

paragraphs.en: We propose MIRA , a musical intent refinement agent that combines tool-grounded objective construction, requirement-level audio verification, budgeted prompt search, and feedback memory without modifying the generation backend.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MIRA，一种音乐意图精炼智能体，它结合了基于工具的目标构建、需求层级的音频验证、预算化的提示搜索以及反馈记忆，而无需修改生成后端。

paragraphs.en: We validate the proposed evaluation through agreement with expert judgments and demonstrate MIRA across three generation generators. With commercial systems as references, our results show that MIRA consistently improves intent alignment and enables an open-source generator to match some representative commercial systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过与专家判断的一致性验证了所提出的评估方法，并在三种生成器上展示了 MIRA 的效果。 以商业系统为参考，我们的结果表明，MIRA 能够持续改进意图对齐，并使开源生成器能够与一些代表性的商业系统相媲美。

paragraphs.en: Music generation evaluation spans distributional fidelity, text–audio correspondence, perceptual quality, and listener preference ( Kilgour et al., 2019 ; Elizalde et al., 2023 ; Deshmukh et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Zhu and Li, 2026 ) . FAD characterizes distribution-level fidelity, whereas CLAP measures broad semantic correspondence between text and audio. Expert ratings and preference datasets capture complementary aspects of perceived quality. Reward-model benchmarks also assess musicality and instruction following under text, lyrics, and reference-audio conditions ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . These complementary perspectives characterize system performance; diagnosing intent alignment additionally requires tracing scores to individual musical requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 音乐生成评估涵盖分布保真度、文本与音频的对应性、感知质量以及听众偏好（Kilgour 等人，2019；Elizalde 等人，2023；Deshmukh 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2025a；Kim 等人，2025；Zhu 和 Li，2026）。 FAD 描述分布层面的保真度，而 CLAP 则衡量文本与音频之间的广泛语义对应性。 专家评分和偏好数据集捕捉了感知质量的不同互补方面。 奖励模型基准还评估了在文本、歌词和参考音频条件下音乐性与指令遵循的能力（Ma 等人，2026）。 这些互补的视角共同刻画了系统的性能；而诊断意图对齐则还需要进一步追溯评分结果与具体音乐需求之间的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Audio-language models enable more detailed assessment: Audio Flamingo 3 supports audio reasoning, while Music Flamingo specializes in musical properties such as harmony, structure, and timbre ( Goel et al., 2025 ; Ghosh et al., 2025 ) . AQAScore measures alignment through targeted audio questions, and AnyAudio-Judge decomposes instructions into binary rubric items ( Kuan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Related text-to-image benchmarks also evaluate verifiable prompt units and examine agreement with human judgments ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2025 ) . Our evaluation follows this item-level approach: MuRA-Bench uses expert-revised rubrics derived from real platform requests, separates explicitly stated requirements from intent inferred from references and context, and pairs these criteria with MF-AQA audio-question-answering scores.
paragraphs.zh: 音频语言模型能够支持更细致的评估：Audio Flamingo 3 支持音频推理，而 Music Flamingo 则专注于和声、结构和音色等音乐特性（Goel et al., 2025；Ghosh et al., 2025）。 AQAScore 通过针对性的音频问题来衡量对齐程度，而 AnyAudio-Judge 则将指令分解为二元评分项（Kuan et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）。 相关的文本到图像基准测试也评估可验证的提示单元，并检验其与人类判断的一致性（Hu et al., 2023；Ghosh et al., 2023；Kamath et al., 2025）。 我们的评估遵循这种项目级方法：MuRA-Bench 使用基于真实平台请求并由专家修订的评分标准，将明确陈述的要求与从参考信息和上下文中推断出的意图区分开来，并将这些标准与 MF-AQA 音频问答分数相结合。

paragraphs.en: Text-conditioned audio and music models provide generation backends ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Agostinelli et al., 2023 ; Copet et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) , with controls over tempo, harmony, instrumentation, vocals, and structure ( Melechovsky et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These controls motivate a complementary question: how can feedback on generated audio guide revisions to an open-ended musical request?

paragraphs.en: Agent research offers mechanisms for such refinement. ReAct supports interaction and external tool use ( Yao et al., 2023b ) ; Self-Refine and Reflexion use iterative feedback and experience memory ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) ; and Tree of Thoughts and LATS search over evaluated reasoning or action trajectories ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . GEPA derives reflective updates from execution trajectories, and GEMS combines persistent memory with domain-specific skills in multimodal generation ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) . These methods make feedback, stored experience, and evaluated alternatives available to a planner; music refinement additionally requires observations grounded in the generated audio. MIRA brings tool-grounded intent completion, requirement-level audio feedback, and branch-specific memory into budgeted prompt search, using unmet requirements to guide repairs across music generation backends without updating their parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体研究为此类优化提供了机制。 ReAct 支持交互和外部工具的使用（Yao 等人，2023b）；Self-Refine 和 Reflexion 使用迭代反馈和经验记忆（Madaan 等人，2023；Shinn 等人，2023）；而 Tree of Thoughts 和 LATS 则对经过评估的推理或行动轨迹进行搜索（Yao 等人，2023a；Zhou 等人，2024）。 GEPA 从执行轨迹中推导出反思性更新，而 GEMS 则将持久记忆与多模态生成中的领域特定技能相结合（Agrawal 等人，2026；He 等人，2026）。 这些方法为规划器提供了反馈、存储的经验以及经过评估的替代方案；音乐优化还要求基于所生成音频的观察结果。 MIRA 将基于工具意图的完成、需求层级的音频反馈以及分支特定的记忆引入预算化的提示搜索中，利用未满足的需求来指导跨音乐生成后端进行修复，而无需更新这些后端的参数。

paragraphs.en: MuRA-Bench contains 100 controlled requests derived from anonymized intent seeds collected on Mureka. Seeds requiring unavailable context, containing sensitive information, or lacking stable musical criteria are excluded. The remaining seeds are normalized while preserving their central intent and realistic expression; raw user logs are not released. The benchmark includes partially specified, reference-based, and hybrid requests with multiple simultaneous constraints.
paragraphs.zh: MuRA-Bench 包含 100 条受控请求，这些请求源自从 Mureka 上收集的去匿名化意图种子。 需要不可用上下文、包含敏感信息或缺乏稳定音乐标准的种子被排除在外。 其余的种子在保留其核心意图和真实表达的同时进行了标准化；原始用户日志不会发布。 该基准测试包括部分指定、基于参考以及具有多种同时约束的混合请求。

paragraphs.en: An instruction-following LLM drafts base and completion requirements and assigns dimensions. Three music experts revise the drafts to preserve explicit constraints, ensure that completed traits are musically plausible and supported by the request or reference context, enforce audible and atomic criteria, and remove or merge redundant or unsupported items. Named artists, songs, and albums are translated into general musical traits rather than direct imitation targets. Items are grouped into seven dimensions: style, instrumentation/vocal, mood, rhythm, harmony/melody, structure/energy, and production/texture. These categories organize request-specific requirements; they do not impose an identical checklist on every request. Figure 1 summarizes the construction process.
paragraphs.zh: 一个遵循指令的大型语言模型会起草基础要求和完成要求，并分配各个维度。 三位音乐专家会对草案进行修订，以保留明确的约束条件，确保完成的音乐特征在音乐上合理且得到请求或参考上下文的支持，强制执行可听且原子的标准，并删除或合并冗余或无依据的项目。 有名称的艺术家、歌曲和专辑会被转化为通用的音乐特征，而非直接的模仿目标。 各项内容被归入七个维度：风格、乐器/人声、情绪、节奏、和声/旋律、结构/能量，以及制作/质感。 这些类别用于组织特定请求的要求；它们不会为每个请求都施加完全相同的检查清单。 图1总结了构建过程。

paragraphs.en: For a generated track a a and a gold rubric item r i r_{i} , we formulate item-level evaluation as a binary audio question-answering task. The evaluator is instructed to determine whether the audible content satisfies r i r_{i} and to answer only yes or no . paragraphs.en: We introduce MIRA (Musical Intent Refinement Agent), a verifier-guided agentic framework that collaborates with any black-box text-to-music generator to improve intent-alignment. A single verification result therefore does not uniquely determine the appropriate repair. Moreover, following a single refinement trajectory may improve one rubric item while degrading others that were previously satisfied. MIRA therefore formulates prompt refinement as rubric-guided search under a finite generation budget.

paragraphs.zh: 在每一层搜索中，智能体都会利用每个保留父节点的提示、项目级观察结果和分支记忆，提出多个完整的候选提示。 从同一前沿扩展出的候选项会被独立生成和验证；只有在该层的所有候选项都经过评估之后，其结果才会被共享。

paragraphs.en: After evaluating a layer, MIRA retains a bounded search frontier. It preserves the candidate with the highest aggregate score and a complementary candidate with stronger mean satisfaction over its lowest-scoring quarter of rubric items; any remaining positions are filled according to aggregate score. The observed rubric state thus determines which candidates are retained and which items are targeted by subsequent repairs, while the search topology remains controlled by the generation budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估完一个层之后，MIRA 会保留一个有界的搜索前沿。 它会保留总分最高的候选者，以及一个补充性候选者——该候选者在评分表项目中得分最低的四分之一项上具有更强的平均满意度；其余位置则根据总分进行填充。 因此，观察到的评分表状态决定了哪些候选者会被保留、哪些项目会成为后续修复的目标，而搜索拓扑结构则由生成预算所控制。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MIRA on ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo ( Gong et al., 2026 ) , SongGeneration2 Large ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , and YuE2-3B ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Multimodal Art Projection, 2026 ) . Kimi 2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) serves as the text planner, and MusicFlamingo provides requirement-level verification ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) . For each backend, generation and verification run on a single NVIDIA A800. We compare against ten commercial models using direct prompting through their official APIs: MiniMax music-2.6/3.0 ( MiniMax, 2026a ; MiniMax, 2026b ) , Mureka V9/V9.5 ( Mureka, 2026b ; Mureka, 2026a ) , StepAudio 3 Music ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , and Suno v4/v4.5/v5/v5.5/v6 ( Suno, 2024 ; Suno, 2025a ; Suno, 2025b ; Suno, 2026a ; Suno, 2026b ) . Main results cover all 100 MuRA-Bench requests; equal-budget comparisons and component analyses use a fixed subset of 20 requests. Evaluator validation covers 100 clips from 25 requests,while system-level human evaluation covers 400 clips from all 100 requests.

paragraphs.en: We assess evaluator agreement using 1,536 rubric-item ratings from 100 clips covering 25 requests. Three music experts independently annotate assigned subsets, with system identities and automatic scores hidden; Appendix B details the protocol. We compare eight evaluation methods. Five use AQA scoring based on normalized yes/no logits ( Kuan et al., 2026 ) : MusicFlamingo (MF-AQA) ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , MOSS-Music-8B ( OpenMOSS Team, 2026 ) , and AnyAudio-Judge-7B ( Li et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: We presented a unified framework for evaluating and improving intent alignment in text-to-music generation. MuRA-Bench converts real-world platform requests into expert-revised rubrics covering explicit constraints and inferred intent, enabling requirement-level evaluation. Agreement with expert judgments supports requirement-targeted audio question answering for fine-grained intent assessment. MIRA integrates tool-grounded intent completion, verifier-guided search, and tree-structured memory to refine black-box music generation. Experiments across three open-source backends demonstrate consistent alignment improvements, enabling an open-source generator to achieve performance comparable to representative commercial systems. Gains over repeated sampling under equal generation budgets further support the effectiveness of this search framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种统一框架，用于评估和改进文本到音乐生成中的意图对齐。 MuRA-Bench 将真实平台请求转化为经过专家修订的评分标准，涵盖显式约束和推断出的意图，从而实现需求层面的评估。 与专家判断的一致性支持了面向需求的音频问答，可用于精细的意图评估。 MIRA 整合了基于工具的意图补全、验证器引导的搜索以及树状结构记忆，以优化黑箱音乐生成过程。 在三种开源后端上进行的实验表明，对齐效果得到了持续改进，使一个开源生成器能够达到与代表性商业系统相当的性能。 在相同生成预算下，重复采样所带来的性能提升进一步验证了该搜索框架的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Check explicit requirements. Compare each base item with the original request. Restore omitted constraints, including negative constraints; remove unsupported additions and duplicates; and correct truncation or changes in meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 检查明确的要求。 将每个基础项与原始请求进行比较。 恢复被省略的约束条件，包括否定性约束；移除无法支持的增加内容和重复项；并纠正截断或含义变化。

paragraphs.en: Identify what needs interpretation. Check whether a named artist, work, scenario, use case, image, or story actually occurs in the request and needs elaboration. If the request is already explicit and complete, leave the completion target and completion requirements empty.
paragraphs.zh: 确定哪些内容需要解释。 检查请求中是否确实出现了某个有名称的艺术家、作品、场景、用例、图像或故事，并且这些内容需要进一步阐述。 如果请求已经明确且完整，则保持完成目标和完成要求为空。

paragraphs.en: Three music experts completed two human-assessment tasks: judging individual rubric requirements and rating intent alignment across generated candidates. For both tasks, assignments were divided approximately equally among the experts without overlapping assignments, and each expert independently assessed their assigned samples. paragraphs.en: We compare unordered pairs of clips generated for the same request, using their clip-level mean scores. Pairs tied under the human score are excluded. These comparisons share clips and should not be interpreted as 147 independent requests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用片段级别的平均分数，对为同一请求生成的无序片段对进行比较。 在人类评分中打平的片段对被排除在外。 仅当自动评分对片段排序的方向与人类评分一致时，该片段对才被视为正确；对于人类评分未打平但自动评分打平的情况，则视为不正确。 数值差异的绝对值低于 10 − 12 10^{-12} 的情况被视为打平。 这 25 个请求在排除三个人类评分打平的情况之前，提供了 150 个候选片段对，最终剩下 147 次比较。 这些比较共享了相同的片段，不应被解释为 147 个独立的请求。

paragraphs.en: The system-level listening study covers all 100 MuRA-Bench requests and 400 audio clips, with four clips per request: direct ACE-Step, ACE-Step with MIRA ( B = 9 B=9 ), MiniMax music-3.0, and Suno v5.5. paragraphs.en: MusicFlamingo receives the audio and one rubric requirement and directly generates a rating from 1 to 5. The prompt instructs it to rely on audible evidence, avoid unsupported inference, and return Score: <number> . Its anchors range from minimal or no audible support to clear and complete satisfaction. The parsed rating s s is normalized as ( s − 1 ) / 4 (s-1)/4 .
paragraphs.zh: MusicFlamingo 接收音频和一条评分标准要求，并直接生成一个从 1 到 5 的评分。 提示词要求它依据可听见的证据进行判断，避免缺乏依据的推断，并返回“得分：<数字>”。 其评分基准范围从几乎没有或完全没有可听见的依据，到完全清晰且令人满意。 解析出的评分 s 被归一化为 (s − 1) / 4。

paragraphs.en: MusicFlamingo first generates one detailed caption per clip without access to the target rubric requirement. The caption covers audible style, instrumentation, vocals, rhythm, harmony, structure, production, mood, and temporal development, while instructing the model not to guess uncertain details. The same caption is reused for all requirements associated with the clip. A text-only Kimi 2.6 judge then receives the caption and one requirement and rates their match from 1 to 5. It is instructed to judge only explicit caption evidence and not treat missing or unclear information as present. The returned rating is normalized as ( s − 1 ) / 4 (s-1)/4 .
paragraphs.zh: MusicFlamingo 首先为每个片段生成一个详细的描述，此时无法访问目标评分标准的要求。 该描述涵盖了可感知的风格、乐器配置、人声、节奏、和声、结构、制作、情绪和时间发展，同时要求模型不要猜测不确定的细节。 同一描述被重复用于与该片段相关的所有要求。 随后，一个仅支持文本的 Kimi 2.6 评判器会接收该描述和一个要求，并对二者的匹配度进行 1 到 5 分的评分。 它被指示仅根据描述中的明确证据进行评判，而不应将缺失或不清晰的信息视为存在。 返回的评分会被归一化为 ( s − 1 ) / 4 (s-1)/4 。

paragraphs.en: Tool grounding and online rubric construction are performed before candidate generation. The online rubric remains fixed throughout the search for each request. With B = 9 B=9 , the controller allocates one generation to the initial candidate, three to exploratory candidates, up to four to expanding two selected parents, and one to a final action from the highest-scoring candidate. Each selected parent produces up to two children. With B = 3 B=3 , the budget covers the initial candidate and two exploratory candidates. Candidates in each expansion batch are evaluated before the next batch is constructed.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成候选项之前，会执行工具基线设定和在线评分标准构建。 对于每个请求，在线评分标准在整个搜索过程中保持不变。 当 B = 9 时，控制器会将一次生成分配给初始候选项，三次分配给探索性候选项，最多四次用于扩展两个选定的父项，以及一次用于从得分最高的候选项执行最终动作。 每个选定的父项最多可生成两个子项。 当 B = 3 时，预算足以覆盖初始候选项和两个探索性候选项。 在构建下一批候选项之前，会先评估当前扩展批次中的所有候选项。

paragraphs.en: The equal-budget comparison and component analysis use the same 20 requests with ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo and YuE2-3B. Direct generation produces one candidate from the original request. Current candidate scores, satisfied and failed requirements, and targeted verifier feedback remain available. Historical requirement locks, successful repair phrases, persistent-failure records, recent experience notes, and tree-contrast memory are omitted. Full MIRA enables these memory inputs while retaining the same search budget and controller.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate intent alignment with two additional evaluators, MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. The assessment covers direct generation and MIRA at B = 3 B=3 and B = 9 B=9 on ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo, SongGeneration2 Large, and YuE2-3B, using all 100 MuRA-Bench requests for every configuration. MusicFlamingo guides search and candidate selection. The alternative evaluators apply AQA scoring to the same selected outputs against the expert-revised gold rubrics. We additionally evaluate representative commercial direct-prompting baselines with both evaluators. Scores follow the aggregation protocol in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用另外两位评估者 MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 来评估意图对齐情况。 该评估涵盖在 ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo、SongGeneration2 Large 和 YuE2-3B 上，于 B = 3 B=3 和 B = 9 B=9 条件下进行的直接生成与 MIRA 评估，且每种配置均使用全部 100 个 MuRA-Bench 请求。 MusicFlamingo 指导搜索与候选选择过程。 替代评估者对相同的选择结果应用 AQA 评分，并与专家修订的黄金评分标准进行比对。 我们还使用两位评估者对具有代表性的商业直接提示基线模型进行了额外评估。 得分遵循正文中所述的聚合协议。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 shows that both MIRA budgets improve Overall, D-Macro, Base, and Comp. over direct generation across all three backends under both evaluators. At B = 9 B=9 , improvements are also observed in all seven musical dimensions. These results demonstrate consistent intent-alignment gains under multiple evaluators. Comparisons are made within each evaluator, since their absolute score scales differ.
paragraphs.zh: 表8显示，在所有三种后端和两种评估器下，MIRA的两种预算设置相较于直接生成方法，在Overall、D-Macro、Base和Comp方面均有提升。 在B = 9时，所有七个音乐维度也观察到了改进。 这些结果表明，在多种评估器下，意图对齐效果均保持一致的提升。 由于不同评估器的绝对评分尺度存在差异，因此比较是在每个评估器内部进行的。

paragraphs.en: Evaluator agreement with human judgments provides additional context for interpreting these results. In Table 1 , Qwen3-Omni shows lower agreement with expert ratings than MusicFlamingo across all six metrics. As a general-purpose multimodal model, Qwen3-Omni may be less sensitive to some fine-grained musical requirements than a music-specialized evaluator. This is a possible explanation rather than a directly tested cause of the agreement gap. We therefore use its scores as complementary evidence, while the stronger expert agreement of MusicFlamingo supports its use as the primary evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器与人类判断的一致性为解读这些结果提供了更多背景信息。 在表 1 中，Qwen3-Omni 在所有六个指标上与专家评分的一致性均低于 MusicFlamingo。 作为一个通用多模态模型，Qwen3-Omni 可能不像专门用于音乐评估的评估器那样对某些精细的音乐要求敏感。 这只是一个可能的解释，而非经过直接验证的一致性差异原因。 因此，我们将它的评分作为补充证据，而 MusicFlamingo 与专家评分更强的一致性则支持将其用作主要评估器。

paragraphs.en: The curated case records contain the original request, prompts before and after revision, generation seeds, node/round identifiers, search actions, verifier feedback, resolved and regressed requirements, tool calls, and evidence cards. An evidence card records its tool/query, claim, supporting text, confidence, and any risk note. These fields allow a prompt edit to be inspected alongside its stated motivation and observed rubric changes.

paragraphs.en: The router exposes three tools. music_reference_lookup accepts an entity, reference type (artist/song/album), and reason. scene_to_music_lookup accepts a scene query, optional scene type, and reason. track_audio_evidence accepts a query or local audio path and a reason. The planner selects tools according to the information required by each request.
paragraphs.zh: 该路由器提供了三种工具。music_reference_lookup 接受一个实体、参考类型（艺术家/歌曲/专辑）和原因。scene_to_music_lookup 接受一个场景查询、可选的场景类型和原因。track_audio_evidence 接受一个查询或本地音频路径以及一个原因。 规划器根据每个请求所需的信息来选择工具。

paragraphs.en: The deterministic evidence gate requires nonempty claim and support fields, a true usable_for_prompt flag, and confidence at least 0.45. An addendum with blocked copy/imitate wording or no accepted evidence card is rejected. Reference-query strings are removed from the addendum before it is appended to the original request. The gate operates on the tool-added text; it does not remove references already present in the user’s request. Evidence admission uses field validation and a confidence threshold; claim support is supplied by the tool and fusion stages.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性证据门要求声明和支持字段非空、「usable_for_prompt」标志为真，且置信度至少为 0.45。 包含受限制文本/模仿措辞或未通过验证的证据卡的补充内容将被拒绝。 在将补充内容附加到原始请求之前，会从中移除参考查询字符串。 该门作用于工具添加的文本；它不会移除用户请求中已存在的引用。 证据采纳使用字段验证和置信度阈值；声明支持由工具和融合阶段提供。

paragraphs.en: Candidate refinement returns a complete replacement prompt. The controller supplies up to eight lowest-scoring checks, compacted to requirement text, probability, and status. The prompt asks for fewer than 110 words; the output guard additionally filters disallowed sentences, removes repeated labels, and clips to 110 words. If fewer than eight words remain, it constructs a fallback from the original request and failure cues.
paragraphs.zh: 候选优化会返回一个完整的替换提示。 控制器最多提供八个得分最低的检查项，并将其压缩为要求文本、概率和状态。 该提示要求字数少于 110 词；输出守卫还会过滤不允许的句子、移除重复的标签，并将字数限制在 110 词以内。 如果剩余字数少于八个词，系统会根据原始请求和失败提示构建一个备用方案。

paragraphs.en: MuRA-Bench is constructed from anonymized intent seeds collected on the Mureka platform, with platform permission for research use and public release of the curated requests. We removed usernames and other personally identifying information, excluded requests containing sensitive information, and retained content relevant to musical intent. We release the curated benchmark rather than raw user logs.
paragraphs.zh: MuRA-Bench 由在 Mureka 平台上收集的匿名化意图种子构建而成，该平台已授权用于研究用途，并允许对经过筛选的请求进行公开发布。 我们移除了用户名和其他个人身份信息，排除了包含敏感信息的请求，并保留了与音乐意图相关的内容。 我们发布的是经过筛选的基准数据集，而非原始用户日志。

paragraphs.en: The participating music experts were informed that their revisions and ratings would be used for research. Both rubric revision and human evaluation followed shared task instructions, with experts independently completing assigned subsets. During human evaluation, system identities and automatic scores were hidden, and experts were instructed to assess fulfillment of musical requirements rather than personal preference.
paragraphs.zh: 参与的音乐专家被告知，他们的修改和评分将用于研究。 评分标准修订和人工评估均遵循共享任务说明，专家独立地完成分配给他们的子集。 在人工评估期间，系统身份和自动评分被隐藏，并指示专家评估音乐要求的满足程度，而非个人偏好。

paragraphs.en: Artist, song, and album references are interpreted as general musical characteristics that can be assessed by listening, rather than direct imitation targets. Their inclusion does not imply endorsement or authorization from the referenced creators. Intent-alignment scores assess fulfillment of musical requirements and do not establish the originality or copyright status of generated audio.
paragraphs.zh: 对艺术家、歌曲和专辑的引用应被理解为可通过聆听评估的一般音乐特征，而非直接模仿的目标。 这些引用的存在并不意味着获得了所提及创作者的认可或授权。 意图对齐分数用于评估音乐要求的满足程度，并不确定生成音频的原创性或版权状态。

paragraphs.en: Implicit musical intent can admit multiple reasonable interpretations. Our expert revision guidelines require contextual support for completed requirements and the removal of personal preferences and overly specific guesses. These checks constrain unsupported interpretations, but model judgments and the perspectives of three experts may still reflect particular musical conventions. MuRA-Bench measures alignment with request-specific rubrics, rather than a universal standard of musical quality or artistic value.
paragraphs.zh: 隐性的音乐意图可能允许多种合理的解释。 我们的专家修订指南要求，已完成的需求必须有上下文支持，并需去除个人偏好和过于具体的猜测。 这些检查可以限制缺乏依据的解释，但模型判断以及三位专家的视角仍可能反映特定的音乐惯例。 MuRA-Bench 衡量的是与特定请求评分标准的契合度，而非音乐质量或艺术价值的通用标准。
